Landing.title: AI Sherlock : Text-Based Mystery Game
Landing.subtitle: Uncover the truth of the case with your questions.
Landing.sim_q1: What was the exact cause of death?
Landing.sim_a1: The autopsy revealed no trace of poison. The cause of death was 'acute cardiac arrest due to severe electric shock'. The victim wore a smart pacemaker.
Landing.sim_q2: Did anyone else enter the basement server room?
Landing.sim_a2: According to the access logs, the door was opened only once at 21:35 by the victim's fingerprint and iris scan. There are no signs of forced entry.
Landing.sim_q3_text: The culprit remotely hacked the victim's pacemaker to induce a fatal shock.
Landing.sim_a3: [Hypothesis Recorded] "The culprit remotely hacked the victim's pacemaker to induce a fatal shock."
Landing.sim_q4: Who has enough internal network access privileges to pull off a pacemaker hack?
Landing.sim_a4: Aside from the victim, the only person with top-level administrator access to the corporate network infrastructure is the Chief AI Researcher, 'Jack Stapleton'.
